paper_title: Context Consistency between Training and Testing in Simultaneous Machine   Translation
caption: BLEU comparison between original Consistency-CE model and ours proposed Consistency-Bi model for wait-1 testing under prefix-constrained decoding setting.
model_annotation: This plot illustrates the BLEU score against the length of the gold prefix during wait-1 testing. The x-axis is labeled “the length of gold prefix” and represents a linear scale ranging from 0 to 20, with tick intervals of 1. The y-axis is labeled “BLEU” and represents a linear scale ranging from approximately 23 to 28, with tick intervals of 1. A blue dashed line with circle markers represents the Consistency-CE model, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 24.5 at a gold prefix length of 0 and decreasing to a BLEU score of approximately 26.5 at a gold prefix length of 15. A red solid line with square markers represents the Consistency-Bi model, beginning at a BLEU score of approximately 25.5 at a gold prefix length of 0 and decreasing to a BLEU score of approximately 27.5 at a gold prefix length of 15.
